mapper.select: SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TZ(o.ordered_at, '+00:00', '+09:00')) AS sales_date, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS revenue FROM ORDERS o INNER JOIN PAYMENT p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.payment_status = 'PAID' AND o.ordered_at >= #{startUtc} AND o.ordered_at < #{endUtc} GROUP BY DATE(CONVERT_TZ(o.ordered_at, '+00:00', '+09:00')) ORDER BY sales_date ASC
SELECT o.order_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS status_count FROM ORDERS o WHERE o.ordered_at >= #{startUtc} AND o.ordered_at < #{endUtc} GROUP BY o.order_status ORDER BY o.order_status ASC

SELECT o.order_id, o.order_number, m.name AS member_name, ( SELECT oi.product_name FROM ORDER_ITEM oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id ORDER BY oi.order_item_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS first_product_name, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDER_ITEM oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id ) AS item_count, o.total_amount, o.order_status, o.ordered_at FROM ( SELECT * FROM ORDERS ORDER BY ordered_at DESC, order_id DESC LIMIT 5 ) o LEFT JOIN MEMBER m ON m.member_id = o.member_id ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC, o.order_id DESC
